near_miss.rationale: Claim a refinement can leave a collapsed pair with different tags unseparated (or merge a pair): the equality of refined reports is exactly equality of both components.
Count every pair with different tags as separated by the tag, ignoring that pairs the old report already separates are not collapsed pairs.
Confuse the odd girth with the chromatic number: the Petersen graph has odd girth 5 and chromatic number 3.
Claim a tag bit is needed when there is no conflict at all; zero bits suffice.
Read the dense complete bipartite graph K33 as non-2-colourable because it has many edges; density is not an odd cycle.
The source shows a Bool triangle cannot be 2-coloured only as a fixed instance; claiming one bit separates a 3-clique reads the supplied-tag theorem as if one tag always settles many conflicts.
A 5-cycle has no triangle yet is not 2-colourable: forgetting the odd-cycle obstruction beyond cliques.
A collapsed fibre of size 3 cannot be separated by one binary tag; the single-pair theorem does not give it.
Treat the supplied tag as determined by the conflict: a proper tag and its complement are two distinct tags, so the choice is not forced.
Count proper tags as if the graph were connected: each connected component can be flipped independently.
Claim a refinement can merge reports the old report distinguished; the old report is retained as a projection so it cannot.
Confuse the number of tag values (chi) with the number of bits (ceil log2 chi).
Report unlabelled graph counts for the labelled enumeration of all graphs on four vertices.
Treat K4 as 2-colourable from a degree argument; a complete graph on 4 vertices needs 4 tag values, i.e. 2 bits.

challenged_predicate: Union-find components and breadth-first two-colouring replace the producer's depth-first components and exhaustive tag enumeration; proper one-bit tags counted as 2^components when bipartite.
Chromatic number by dynamic programming over vertex subsets (cover by independent sets), minimal bits as bit_length(chi-1); the producer uses backtracking colourings with 2^b colours.
Odd girth as the least odd k with nonzero trace of A^k; the producer uses breadth-first levels.
Enumeration identity: sum over bipartite G of 2^c(G) equals sum_k C(n,k) 2^(k(n-k)); labelled bipartite count equals graphs with at most one bit.
